doc.p: A display box is a block like a display group: the paragraph before it, the box, and the paragraph after it follow one another down the page.

warning.p: The DocBook print stylesheets put a warning or a caution in a display box with a border and a centered title, as this one is.
Its paragraphs are indented by the start-indent of the box, and it is never a column set, though it is a group.

doc.p: After the box the text goes on at the indent of the page, and an inline box such as this one stays in its line.
